chapter_title: Lab: Packed SFT Run with Masking Tests
course_outline_concepts: Train a small (~3B) model on a 100K-sample mix combining your synthetic set (ch-29) and LIMA
Write unit tests for: chat-template rendering, loss-mask positions, packed cross-sample attention block
Run three ablations: packed vs unpacked, prompt-masked vs full-loss, with vs without NEFTune
Evaluate on a small MT-Bench-style suite; report a per-slice regression table
Deliverable: sft-run-memo.md with ablation table + one regression caught via the masking tests
Resource-constrained path: ~1B model on 20K-sample mix; run one ablation axis (packed vs unpacked) instead of three; masking-tests requirement is unchanged.

sources.what_to_extract: cu_seqlens offsets, per-sub-sequence position-id reset, block-diagonal attention mask, flash_attn_varlen_func interface, SPFHP bin-packing, 2x throughput claim.

Four failure modes (missing block-diagonal mask, un-reset position ids, label mask not re-applied per sub-sequence, dense flash_attn instead of varlen); diagnostic procedure (100-step packed vs unpacked loss-curve diff > 0.01 nats = bug); throughput model speedup ~ L_max/avg(L_i).
labels[:prompt_len] = -100; multi-turn masks all user turns plus assistant turns 1..k-1; per-sub-sequence mask reset inside a packed block; Shi 2024 MT-Bench delta.
X_tilde = X + Uniform(-1,1) * alpha / sqrt(L*d); alpha in {5,10,15}; gain saturates on large SFT mixes (Tulu 3 reports neutral at 939K); stacks with packing and masking.

SFTConfig(packing=True, train_on_response_only=True, max_seq_length=2048); Zephyr hparams (LR 2e-5 cosine 10% warmup, BF16, FSDP FULL_SHARD, 1 epoch, global batch 128); 'decode a packed batch to verify chat template' rule.
Tulu 3 SFT hparams (LR 5e-6 linear 3% warmup, 2 epochs, packing yes, response-only, NEFTune off at 939K); packed ablation 2.5x throughput no quality delta; decontamination requirement.
Skill-specific mix composition (chat, math, code, IF, safety, multilingual); decontamination against eval sets; skill-specific submixes before merge.
1K handcurated seed; Superficial Alignment Hypothesis; LR schedule that drops through epochs to avoid overfit on a small set; the lab's baseline slice.
'Neural net training fails silently'; overfit-one-batch sanity; predict-outcome-before-run; ordered regularizer list; monitor clip-norm; all three ablations need one-change-one-prediction discipline.
FULL_SHARD memory formula; auto_wrap_policy on LlamaDecoderLayer; BF16 mixed precision defaults; typical 70B recipe (extrapolated down to 3B and 1B in this lab).

hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Unit-test snippets must be concrete pytest (not pseudocode) with real import paths and assertions
Quote attested parameter values from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults when not attested

Capstone rule: the chapter must close the SFT track - it integrates packing (ch-33), masking (ch-32), NEFTune (ch-35), chat templates (ch-31), Tulu 3 + HF Alignment Handbook recipes, with synthetic set from ch-29 and LIMA as baselines
